name: Create Marketing Email
description: Create a marketing email in Hubspot. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/emails/marketing-emails#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Femails%2F)

configurable_props.name: campaign
configurable_props.label: Campaign ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the campaign to create the email in.

configurable_props.name: customReplyTo
configurable_props.label: Custom Reply To
configurable_props.description: The custom reply to address for the email

configurable_props.name: replyTo
configurable_props.label: Reply To
configurable_props.description: The reply to address for the email

configurable_props.name: limitSendFrequency
configurable_props.label: Limit Send Frequency
configurable_props.description: Whether to limit the send frequency for the email

configurable_props.name: suppressGraymail
configurable_props.label: Suppress Graymail
configurable_props.description: Whether to suppress graymail for the email

configurable_props.name: includeContactLists
configurable_props.label: Lists
configurable_props.description: Select the lists to watch for new contacts.

configurable_props.name: excludeContactLists
configurable_props.label: Lists
configurable_props.description: Select the lists to watch for new contacts.

configurable_props.name: feedbackSurveyId
configurable_props.label: Feedback Survey ID
configurable_props.description: Hubspot's internal ID for the feedback survey

configurable_props.name: rssData
configurable_props.label: RSS Data
configurable_props.description: An object with the RSS data for the email. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/emails/marketing-emails#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Femails%2F) for more information.

configurable_props.name: testing
configurable_props.label: Testing
configurable_props.description: An object with the testing data for the email. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/emails/marketing-emails#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Femails%2F) for more information.

configurable_props.name: content
configurable_props.label: Content
configurable_props.description: An object with the content data for the email. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/emails/marketing-emails#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Femails%2F) for more information.

configurable_props.name: webversion
configurable_props.label: Webversion
configurable_props.description: An object with the webversion data for the email. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/emails/marketing-emails#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Femails%2F) for more information.

configurable_props.name: subscriptionDetails
configurable_props.label: Subscription Details
configurable_props.description: An object with the subscription details for the email. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/marketing/emails/marketing-emails#post-%2Fmarketing%2Fv3%2Femails%2F) for more information.

configurable_props.name: sendOnPublish
configurable_props.label: Send On Publish
configurable_props.description: Whether to send the email on publish
